notes: The Events section is simpler to use: clearer mode buttons, one line per card, folded lists. Exchange Extravaganza quests can be kept or skipped by group; Apex works the quest at the top of the queue, claims it when done and exchanges coins as soon as they cover one. It starts in Watch mode, logging what it would do, until switched to Act. Gather types, pacts, monster types and supply resources are shown by name.
